summary.text: Cory Maloy is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 52, where he has served since 2017, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A public relations professional from Lehi, he holds degrees from Ricks College and Brigham Young University.

paragraphs.text: He earned an associate degree in business from Ricks College in Idaho and a bachelor's degree in communications with an emphasis in public relations from Brigham Young University.

His career has included owning and operating his own public relations business, serving as executive vice president and public relations strategist at SnappConner PR, and working as director of public relations and corporate communications at MediConnect.
Maloy has served in the Utah House since 2017, and Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the House Government Operations Committee in 2021-2022.
